company_brief.summary: Ballard Mining Limited (ASX:BM1) is a Western Australian gold exploration and development company formed via a 2025 demerger from Delta Lithium to hold and advance the Mt Ida Gold Project, a fully-permitted, multi-deposit gold asset in the Eastern Goldfields near Menzies, WA. Its strategy is to grow the resource through aggressive regional and infill drilling (targeting ~130,000-220,000m programs) around the flagship high-grade Baldock deposit while advancing development studies toward production.

Ramelius Resources Limited (ASX:RMS) is a Western Australian gold producer that mines and processes ore from a growing portfolio of open-pit and underground operations centred on its Mt Magnet processing hub in the Murchison region, plus the Vivien underground mine and the Rebecca-Roe development project near Kalgoorlie. The company has grown mainly by acquisition (Spectrum Metals/Penny 2020, Musgrave Minerals/Cue 2023, Breaker Resources/Roe 2023-24, Apollo Consolidated/Rebecca 2021, Spartan Resources/Dalgaranga 2025) and in mid-2026 divested its legacy Edna May hub (Edna May, Marda, Tampia, Symes) to Forrestania Resources, while pursuing a pathway to 500,000oz/year production by FY30.

Turaco Gold Limited (ASX:TCG), formerly Manas Resources Limited, is an ASX-listed gold exploration and development company advancing the Afema Gold Project in south-east Côte d'Ivoire, West Africa. Afema hosts a 4.65Moz JORC gold resource and a 2026 Pre-Feasibility Study targeting ~200,000oz/year production over a 10+ year mine life. Historically the company (as Manas Resources) explored gold-copper projects in the Kyrgyz Republic, and later (as Turaco) held and then divested the Boundiali gold project in Côte d'Ivoire to Aurum Resources (ASX:AUE) to help fund Afema.

Marmota Limited (ASX: MEU) is a South Australian minerals explorer focused on gold, with secondary uranium and titanium/heavy-mineral interests. Its flagship is the Gawler Gold Project in the Gawler Craton of South Australia — a cluster of adjacent deposits including the Aurora Tank discovery and the newer high-grade Greenewood discovery (90% via the Golden Moon JV), with a maiden Aurora Tank resource and scoping study in progress. It also holds the Junction Dam uranium project next to Boss Energy's Honeymoon mine, and the Muckanippie titanium/heavy-mineral and rare-earth discovery, both in South Australia.

company_brief.summary: Titan Minerals Limited (ASX:TTM) is an Australian-listed gold and copper explorer/developer focused on southern Ecuador's Andean mineral belt, anchored by its 100%-owned flagship Dynasty Gold Project. It also holds the Linderos Copper Project (partner-funded by Hancock Prospecting's Hanrine) and the early-stage Copper Duke porphyry project, having divested its legacy Peru gold assets in 2020 to concentrate on Ecuador.

Focus Minerals Limited (ASX:FML) is a Western Australian gold producer, majority-owned by Shandong Gold International Mining Corporation. Its current business centres on the 100%-owned Coolgardie Gold Project in WA's Eastern Goldfields, restarting open-pit and underground gold production through the Three Mile Hill processing plant. It formerly also held the Laverton Gold Project (acquired via Focus Technologies/Crescent Gold), which it sold to Genesis Minerals for A$250m in 2025.

Ausgold Limited is a Perth-based gold developer whose flagship asset is the 100%-owned Katanning Gold Project (KGP) in the Katanning Greenstone Belt of Western Australia's south-west Yilgarn Craton, about 275km southeast of Perth. A Definitive Feasibility Study was completed in 2025 and updated in 2026, and the company is progressing early works, permitting and financing toward a final investment decision and first production. Ausgold also runs regional gold exploration across roughly 3,000km2 of surrounding Katanning tenure, and has farmed out the Kulin gold project to Critica.

company_brief.summary: Catalyst Metals is an ASX-listed gold producer whose business is centred on the Plutonic Gold Belt in Western Australia, where it mines Plutonic Main, Plutonic East, the Trident open pit/underground and K2, all feeding the company-owned Plutonic processing mill. It produced about 104,000oz in FY26 and is developing Trident underground, Old Highway (bought from Sandfire) and Cinnamon to lift output toward roughly 200,000oz a year. It also retains earlier-stage gold exploration ground in central Victoria (Tandarra, Four Eagles, Drummartin); the Henty gold mine in Tasmania was sold in 2025.

company_brief.summary: Gorilla Gold Mines is a Western Australian gold explorer, renamed from Labyrinth Resources in February 2025. Its focus is the North Kalgoorlie Hub — the Comet Vale project (including the Sovereign, Lakeview and Happy Jack lodes) and Mulwarrie 50km to the west — plus the Vivien gold project near Leinster, with a combined WA resource base of roughly 1.5Moz at ~3.8 g/t gold. It also retains the Labyrinth and Denain gold projects in Quebec, Canada, which it attempted to sell in 2024 before the sale was terminated.
projects: Comet Vale (incl. Sovereign, Lakeview, Happy Jack)

company_brief.summary: MetalsTech Limited (ASX:MTC) is an Australian mineral exploration and development company advancing its flagship Sturec Gold-Silver Project, a brownfields underground mine near Kremnica in central Slovakia, toward production. It also holds early-stage lithium exploration ground in Quebec, Canada, and previously explored a portfolio of cobalt-silver projects in Ontario, Canada, having spun off its earlier Quebec lithium assets into ASX-listed Winsome Resources in 2021.

company_brief.summary: Strickland Metals is an ASX-listed gold and base metals explorer whose sole flagship is the Rogozna gold-copper project in the Raska district of southern Serbia, with a combined resource of about 9.2Moz AuEq across the Shanac, Gradina, Medenovac and Copper Canyon deposits. It divested its Western Australian assets: Millrose was sold to Northern Star in 2023 and the remaining Yandal project was sold to Gateway Mining in 2026, with Gateway shares distributed in-specie to holders. The company is advancing development studies at Rogozna alongside a large ongoing drill program.
projects: Rogozna (Shanac, Gradina, Medenovac, Copper Canyon deposits; Kotlovi, Obradov Potok, Jezerska Reka, Red Creek prospects)

company_brief.summary: New Murchison Gold Limited (ASX:NMG, formerly Ora Gold Limited, formerly Thundelarra Limited) is a Western Australian gold explorer and producer whose flagship Garden Gully Gold Project near Meekatharra hosts the newly commissioned Crown Prince open-pit gold mine plus a pipeline of nearby resource-growth deposits. Prior to refocusing on Murchison gold around 2018-19, the company (as Thundelarra) explored a diversified copper/nickel/uranium portfolio in WA's East Kimberley and the Northern Territory, most of which has since been divested or sits as minor non-core JV interests.

Emmerson Resources is a Perth-based explorer whose main asset is a ~1,700 km2 tenement holding covering most of the Tennant Creek Mineral Field in the Northern Territory, held largely through joint ventures with Tennant Mining and Australian Gold and Copper partners. Its flagship is the White Devil gold deposit (616,200 oz), which has been declared a major mine under the JV, alongside earlier Tennant Creek gold resources (Chariot, Mauretania, Golden Forty, Eldorado, Black Snake) and the Hermitage copper-gold discovery. It also holds copper-gold exploration ground in the Macquarie Arc of New South Wales (Kiola, Kadungle, Fifield, Wellington). Emmerson was acquired by Pan African Resources under a scheme of arrangement and has been removed from the ASX Official List.
projects: Tennant Creek Mineral Field (Chariot, Mauretania, Black Snake, Golden Forty, Eldorado, Nobles)

company_brief.summary: Kingfisher Mining Limited (ASX:KFM) is a Perth-based mineral exploration company that in late 2025 pivoted away from its earlier Western Australian rare earth, lithium and copper-gold exploration (Gascoyne and Ashburton regions) to acquire a portfolio of copper-gold and base/precious-metal projects around Broken Hill and Cobar in far-west NSW. Its current flagship is the Copper Blow IOCG copper-gold project (75% Kingfisher / 25% Broken Hill Mines JV), where it is drilling toward a maiden JORC mineral resource, alongside earlier-stage Pb-Zn-Ag, Cu-Co and Au targets across the same NSW tenement package.

Perseus Mining Limited (ASX: PRU) is an Australian mid-tier gold producer with mining and exploration operations in West and East Africa. It operates three producing gold mines — Edikan (Ghana), Sissingué and Yaouré (Côte d'Ivoire) — and is developing the Nyanzaga Gold Project in Tanzania, with first gold targeted for early 2027.

Southern Cross Gold Consolidated Ltd (ASX: SX2, TSX: SXGC) is a gold and antimony explorer focused on Victoria's historic epizonal goldfields in Australia, with its flagship Sunday Creek Gold-Antimony Project plus the Redcastle project. It also explores for IOCG/Broken Hill-type Pb-Zn-Ag mineralisation at Mt Isa, Queensland. The company was formed by a reverse-merger of Mawson Gold Limited's Victorian spin-out and the former ASX-listed Southern Cross Gold Ltd, beginning trading as SX2 in January 2025.

Aruma Resources Limited (ASX:AAJ) is an Australian minerals exploration company that began as a Western Australian gold and lithium explorer and has since diversified into copper and uranium. Its current flagship is the high-grade Tillex Copper-Silver Project in Ontario, Canada, supported by copper projects in Queensland's Mt Isa district, an IOCG-uranium project in South Australia, and gold/gallium/REE projects in the WA Pilbara and Eastern Goldfields.

Kalgoorlie Gold Mining Limited (KalGold, ASX: KAL) is a gold exploration company based in West Perth that listed on the ASX in late 2020 and operates across Western Australia's Eastern Goldfields. Its flagship is the Pinjin Gold Project on the southern Laverton Tectonic Zone, which hosts the Kirgella Gift/Providence resource and the newer Lighthorse and Wessex discoveries. Secondary gold tenements include Bulong Taurus, La Mascotte, Perrinvale, Zelica, Ninga Mia and a recently acquired package in the Central Yandal belt; the Yarri tenements were sold.
projects: Pinjin (incl. Kirgella Gift, Providence, Lighthorse, Wessex, Rebecca West)

company_brief.summary: Nexus Minerals Limited (ASX:NXM) is a West Perth-based gold exploration company focused on the Eastern Goldfields of Western Australia, with its flagship Wallbrook Gold Project plus the Pinnacles gold projects, alongside earlier-stage Bethanga porphyry copper-gold (Victoria) and NSW critical-minerals (lithium-caesium-tantalum pegmatite) ground. The company was previously known as Hemisphere Resources Limited, an iron ore and nickel explorer, before pivoting to gold in the Eastern Goldfields from 2018.

New Age Exploration is an ASX-listed minerals explorer focused on gold in the Pilbara region of Western Australia and the Otago region of New Zealand. Its flagship is the Wagyu Gold Project in the central Pilbara, within a ~1,893 sq km gold-lithium tenement package, alongside the Lammerlaw gold-antimony project and other Otago gold permits in New Zealand. In March 2026 it acquired the Wallah Silver Project near Yass in the NSW Lachlan Fold Belt. All projects are exploration stage with no mineral resource estimates.

Golden Horse Minerals Limited (ASX:GHM, formerly Altan Rio Minerals) is an Australian gold exploration company focused on the Southern Cross Greenstone Belt in Western Australia, where its flagship Hopes Hill project sits alongside the Hakes Find project and regional targets across ~1,900km2 of tenure. It also holds the Sorrel copper project in the Northern Territory (formerly Redbank), and previously explored a large copper-gold porphyry project in Mongolia under its former name.

Emerald Resources NL (ASX:EMR) is an Australian gold mining and exploration company whose flagship asset is the 100%-owned Okvau Gold Mine in Cambodia, a producing open-pit/underground operation that has poured over 440koz of gold since 2021. It is also developing a second Cambodian mine (Memot) and a new Western Australian operation (Dingo Range), alongside regional exploration licences in Cambodia and a recently divested legacy WA project (Southern Cross).

Beacon Minerals Limited (ASX:BCN) is a gold producer, developer and explorer based in the Eastern Goldfields of Western Australia, operating an owner-operator model around its 100%-owned Jaurdi processing plant near Coolgardie. It mines multiple open-pit gold deposits (Jaurdi, MacPhersons, Lady Ida) and has recently divested a Timor-Leste copper exploration project to refocus purely on Australian gold.

Minerals 260 Limited (ASX: MI6) is a Western Australian gold developer that listed on the ASX in November 2021 as a spin-out from Liontown Resources. Its flagship asset is the 100%-owned Bullabulling Gold Project near Coolgardie in WA's Eastern Goldfields, acquired in early 2025, which hosts a JORC Mineral Resource of 190Mt at 1.0 g/t for 6.2Moz of gold (July 2026) and has completed a Pre-Feasibility Study, with early construction underway. The company also retains earlier-stage WA exploration ground — Moora, the Koojan JV, Dingo Rocks and Yalwest — prospective for copper-gold and PGEs; the Aston lithium-REE project was sold in 2025.

company_brief.summary: Great Boulder Resources (ASX:GBR) is a Western Australian gold exploration company whose current focus is growing a combined ~1.5Moz resource base at its Side Well (Meekatharra) and Peak Hill gold projects in the Murchison region, alongside the Whiteheads gold project near Kalgoorlie. It also holds the early-stage Wellington zinc-lead project in the Earaheedy Basin. The company previously explored copper-nickel-cobalt base metals at its Yamarna Project (Mt Venn / Eastern Mafic), which it demerged into a separate ASX-listed company, Cosmo Metals, in January 2022.

Horizon Gold Limited (ASX:HRN) is a Perth-based, single-project gold exploration and development company, majority-owned by Zeta Resources. It owns 100% of the Gum Creek Gold Project in Western Australia's Yilgarn Craton, a historic gold camp it has been advancing through resource drill-out toward a definitive feasibility study targeting first production in 2028.

Siren Gold Limited (ASX:SNG) is a New Zealand-focused gold and antimony explorer, originally built around the Reefton Goldfield on the South Island's West Coast, which it sold to TSX-V-listed Rua Gold in 2025/2026 for ~A$20-22M cash and scrip. It now advances the Sams Creek gold project (824koz JORC resource, Golden Bay) as its flagship, alongside the earlier-stage Langdons and Queen Charlotte antimony-gold projects.

Antipa Minerals (ASX:AZY) is a Western Australian gold-copper explorer and developer focused on the Paterson Province, where it holds an extensive ~4,000-4,500km² tenement package surrounding its flagship Minyari Dome Gold-Copper Development Project. The company also explores its wholly-owned Wilki and Paterson projects, and until September 2024 held a joint-venture interest (funded by Rio Tinto) in the nearby Citadel gold-copper project.

Westgold Resources Limited (ASX/TSX: WGX) is an Australian mid-tier gold producer operating four underground/open-pit processing hubs in Western Australia: the Cue, Meekatharra and Fortnum (Bryah Basin) hubs of the Murchison region, plus the Beta Hunt and Higginsville operations in the Southern Goldfields near Kambalda. It grew from the 2011-founded Central Murchison gold business (built around the historic Big Bell mine) into a ~400koz/yr producer via the 1 August 2024 merger with Canada's Karora Resources, which added Beta Hunt and Higginsville and gave the company a dual ASX/TSX listing.

Gateway Mining Limited (ASX:GML) is a Western Australian gold (and base metal) exploration company. Historically centred on the Gidgee Gold Project near Sandstone, it transformed in 2025 by acquiring Strickland Metals' 400,400oz Yandal Gold Project, which is now its flagship, alongside the newly acquired Glenburgh South gold project.

company_brief.summary: Black Cat Syndicate is a Western Australian gold producer operating the Paulsens underground mine in the eastern Pilbara and the Kal East operation (with the Lakewood mill) east of Kalgoorlie. It is advancing the high-grade Coyote gold project in the Tanami region on the WA/NT border, and holds the Mt Clement antimony project near Paulsens.

company_brief.summary: Tesoro Gold Limited (formerly Tesoro Resources; renamed April 2022) is a Fremantle-based gold explorer and developer whose sole focus is the El Zorro Gold Project in the Atacama region of northern Chile, in which it holds a ~95% interest. Its flagship asset is the Ternera gold deposit, which carries a Mineral Resource Estimate of about 1.82 Moz of gold and is currently the subject of a Definitive Feasibility Study. The wider El Zorro land package covers several hundred square kilometres and contains additional early-stage gold prospects such as La Brea, Drone Hill, Pena Blanca and Calderillas.
projects: El Zorro district prospects (La Brea, Drone Hill, Pena Blanca, Calderillas, Ternera East, Buzzard)

company_brief.summary: Aurum Resources Limited (ASX:AUE) is a gold exploration and development company focused on the Boundiali and Napié Gold Projects in Côte d'Ivoire, West Africa. It grew rapidly from its Boundiali IPO asset via an aggressive multi-rig diamond drilling campaign, then in 2025 acquired Mako Gold Limited (ASX:MKG), bringing the Napié gold project and Korhogo manganese project into the group.

Flynn Gold Limited (ASX:FG1) is an Australian mineral exploration company listed on the ASX in June 2021, focused primarily on gold (and associated tungsten/silver/base metals) exploration across a 100%-owned portfolio of tenements in Tasmania, with Golden Ridge as its flagship project. It previously also held a suite of lithium-gold exploration projects in Western Australia (Pilbara and Forrestania/Lake Johnston belt) which have been progressively divested through 2025-2026 to concentrate resources on the Tasmanian gold/tungsten/silver portfolio.

Meeka Metals (formerly Latitude Consolidated, ticker LCD until late 2021) is a Western Australian gold producer. Its flagship Murchison Gold Project (Andy Well, Turnberry, St Anne's deposits) in the Murchison goldfields of WA poured first gold in July 2025 and is ramping up production, with a plant upgrade to 800ktpa underway. It also holds the Circle Valley gold project in the Albany-Fraser belt and acquired Mt Holland South in 2026.
projects: Murchison Gold Project (Andy Well / Turnberry / St Anne's / Gnaweeda)

company_brief.summary: Odyssey Gold Limited (ASX:ODY) is a Western Australian gold explorer and developer advancing its 80%-owned Tuckanarra and Stakewell Gold Projects in the Murchison Goldfields between Cue and Meekatharra, WA. The company pivoted from oil & gas exploration (as Odyssey Energy Limited) to gold in 2020 and is now progressing Tuckanarra toward a low-capex toll-treatment production start targeted for early 2027, alongside ongoing resource-growth and exploration drilling at both projects.

Predictive Discovery Limited (ASX/TSX: PDI) is a West African gold company, formed in its current shape by the merger of equals with Robex Resources completed in April 2026. Its assets are the producing Kiniero Gold Mine and the large Bankan Gold Project (both in Guinea) plus the operating Nampala Gold Mine in Mali. Gold is its only commodity, and it is targeting more than 400,000oz of annual production by 2029.

Pacgold Limited (ASX:PGO) is a Brisbane-based Australian gold (and antimony) exploration and development company. Its flagship asset is the Alice River Gold Project in North Queensland (474koz maiden pit-constrained resource within an 854koz global estimate), and it also owns the restarting White Dam heap-leach gold operation in South Australia and holds an earn-in over the St George gold-antimony project in North Queensland.

Hamelin Gold Limited (ASX:HMG) is a Western Australia-focused gold explorer (IPO'd Nov 2021, no resources/production yet) running a district-scale, geochemistry-led generative exploration model across the Tanami, Paterson and Yilgarn provinces. It uses proprietary ultra-fine soil sampling (UFF) plus aircore/RC/diamond drilling to define targets under cover, and counts Gold Fields Ltd and Vault Minerals Ltd as major shareholders.

Red Mountain Mining Limited (ASX:RMX) is a Subiaco (WA)-based critical minerals and gold exploration company, ASX-listed since 2011, that holds a wide portfolio of early-to-mid-stage exploration projects across the USA, Australia and Canada. Historically a WA gold/REE explorer (Mt Maitland, Kiabye, Mt Mansbridge), it has pivoted since late 2024/2025 into a diversified antimony-led critical minerals strategy, with its flagship now the Armidale Antimony-Gold Project in NSW alongside a cluster of US antimony, tungsten and lithium projects and Canadian gold/niobium ground.

Solstice Minerals (ASX:SLS) is a Western Australian minerals explorer that demerged from OreCorp and listed on the ASX on 2 May 2022. Its flagship is the 100%-owned Nanadie copper-gold project in the Murchison district near Meekatharra, acquired from Cyprium Metals in early 2026, which carries an inherited Inferred Resource of 40.4Mt @ 0.40% Cu and 0.10g/t Au (162,000t copper, 130,000oz gold) and is the focus of current RC and diamond drilling. The company also runs its own gold exploration in the Eastern Goldfields at the Yarri project (Bluetooth, Statesman Well, Edjudina Range, Bunjarra prospects) plus the earlier-stage Kalgoorlie and Ponton holdings.

Magnetic Resources NL was a gold developer focused on the Lady Julie Gold Project in the Laverton district of Western Australia, whose LJN4 deposit holds a resource of about 2.24Moz at 1.78g/t Au. Nearby satellite gold prospects include Hawks Nest 9 and Homeward Bound South. The company was acquired by Genesis Minerals (ASX:GMD) via a scheme of arrangement completed mid-2026 and has been removed from the ASX official list; the Laverton assets now sit within Genesis.

It operates three Western Australian gold operations - Leonora (King of the Hills open pit/underground plus the Darlot satellite underground mine), Mount Monger, and the Deflector gold-copper mine (with satellite Rothsay) - and is progressing a restart of the Sugar Zone (White River) underground gold mine in Ontario, Canada.

company_brief.summary: Artemis Resources is a gold and copper exploration company focused on the Karratha district in Western Australia's West Pilbara, where it holds the Greater Carlow gold-copper-cobalt deposit (Inferred MRE, Oct 2022) and the newer Titan / Titan East gold discovery. It is also exploring the Cassowary IOCG copper-gold target in the Madura Province about 450 km east of Kalgoorlie, and retains a lithium joint-venture interest at Osborne with GreenTech Metals. It formerly held the Munni Munni PGM project (sold 2022) and Paterson Central (no longer an active project).
projects: Karratha Gold-Copper Project (Carlow, Titan/Titan East, Lulu Creek)

company_brief.summary: Kaiser Reef Limited (ASX: KAU) is an Australian gold producer and explorer. It owns and operates the Henty Gold Mine in western Tasmania (underground mine plus a 300,000tpa CIL plant, ~26koz Au in FY25, acquired from Catalyst Metals in 2025) and the Maldon Gold Project in central Victoria, which includes the permitted Union Hill underground mine and a 200,000tpa processing plant. Its earlier Victorian asset, the A1 Gold Mine, has been placed on care and maintenance following a strategic review, and its former NSW copper-gold ground (Macquarie North) was divested.

company_brief.summary: Saturn Metals Limited (ASX:STN) is a Western Australian gold exploration and development company. Its sole focus is the 100%-owned Apollo Hill Gold Project near Leonora, WA, a large-tonnage, low-grade, low-strip open-pit gold deposit (2.83Moz resource, 1.59Moz maiden ore reserve) being advanced through a Definitive Feasibility Study toward a heap-leach mining operation. It previously held a JV gold exploration project at West Wyalong, NSW, which it divested in 2026 to concentrate on Apollo Hill.

Alkane Resources (ASX:ALK, also TSX:ALK) is a multi-commodity gold producer, developer and explorer headquartered in Perth, Australia. Following its August 2025 all-share merger with Canada's Mandalay Resources, it now operates three mines - Tomingley (NSW gold, its original flagship), Costerfield (Victoria gold-antimony) and Björkdal (Sweden gold) - while advancing the Boda-Kaiser gold-copper porphyry discovery in NSW as its major growth project. It has previously divested the Dubbo Zirconia/rare-earths project (demerged as Australian Strategic Materials in 2020) and the McPhillamys gold project (sold to Regis Resources in 2012).

Ora Banda Mining Ltd (ASX:OBM) is a Western Australian gold producer and 100% owner of the Davyhurst Gold Project, ~120km NW of Kalgoorlie in the Eastern Goldfields. It runs the Davyhurst processing plant plus underground mines at Riverina and Sand King, targeting ~150koz gold production in FY26. The company was formerly known as Monarch Gold Mining Company, then Swan Gold Mining, then Eastern Goldfields Limited, before adopting the Ora Banda name in 2019.

Brightstar Resources Limited (ASX:BTR) is a Western Australian gold consolidator that owns and operates three project hubs — Sandstone, Laverton and Menzies — totalling over 4 million ounces of gold Mineral Resources. It is transitioning from explorer to multi-mine producer, currently mining ore from underground mines at Second Fortune and Fish (processed via an ore purchase agreement with Genesis Minerals at Laverton), while advancing its flagship Sandstone Gold Project toward a Pre-Feasibility Study and a standalone processing plant. The company was formerly known as A1 Minerals then Stone Resources Australia (ASX:SHK) before rebranding to Brightstar Resources in December 2020, and grew via a string of 2023-2024 mergers/acquisitions (Alto Metals, Aurumin, Linden Gold Alliance, Gateway Mining's Montague tenements).

De Grey Mining Limited (ASX:DEG) is a West Australian gold explorer/developer whose flagship asset is the Hemi Gold Project, a major intrusion-hosted gold discovery within its Mallina Gold Project tenement package in the Pilbara, ~60km SW of Port Hedland. De Grey advanced Hemi from 2019 discovery through to an 11.2Moz JORC resource and DFS before being acquired by Northern Star Resources in May 2025 (now a subsidiary, delisted from ASX).

West African Resources is a Perth-headquartered gold producer operating in Burkina Faso, West Africa. Its flagship assets are the Sanbrado gold mine (in production since 2020) and the larger Kiaka gold mine (first gold poured mid-2025), both 85%-owned, plus the Toega satellite deposit that trucks ore to the Sanbrado plant. The company produced over 300,000 oz of gold in 2025 and guides to a 10-year average of about 533,000 oz per annum.

Genesis Minerals Limited (ASX:GMD) is a Western Australian gold producer 100% focused on the Leonora and Laverton districts near Kalgoorlie. Its business is built on the Gwalia underground mine plus a cluster of satellite open-pit and underground deposits feeding its own Leonora and Laverton processing mills, built up rapidly through 2023-2025 acquisitions (Dacian Gold's Mt Morgans, St Barbara's Leonora assets, Kin Mining's Bruno-Lewis/Raeside, and Focus Minerals' Laverton Gold Project).

Havilah Resources Limited (ASX:HAV) is a South Australian mineral exploration and development company holding a large multi-commodity tenement package (~11,000-16,000 km²) across the Curnamona Province in northeastern South Australia. Its flagship asset is the Kalkaroo copper-gold-cobalt deposit (now subject to a Sandfire Resources earn-in), alongside the Mutooroo copper-cobalt-gold deposit (Hillgrove farm-in), the Grants and Maldorky iron ore projects, and the divested Portia gold mine (SA's first-ever gold pour by Havilah, 2015-2018). It also formerly controlled uranium/tin ground (Radium Hill, Lake Namba-Billeroo, Prospect Hill) largely farmed out to Heavy Rare Earths in 2024.

Kingston Resources Limited (ASX:KSN) is an Australian mining company whose current flagship is the Mineral Hill gold-copper-zinc-lead-silver mine in central-west NSW, acquired from Quintana Minerals in early 2022 and now in production. It previously held the Misima Gold Project in Papua New Guinea (a past-producing Placer Dome mine acquired via the 2017 WCB Resources merger) and the Livingstone Gold Project in WA, both of which it has since divested.

Barton Gold Holdings Limited (ASX: BGD) is a South Australian gold explorer and developer working toward restarting production in the Gawler Craton. It holds 100% of the Tunkillia gold-silver project (1.6Moz Au, 3.1Moz Ag), the Challenger gold project with the fully permitted Central Gawler Mill, the Tarcoola goldfield (including the Tolmer gold-silver discovery), and the recently acquired Wudinna gold project. A Definitive Feasibility Study is underway for a Stage 1 restart at Challenger/Central Gawler Mill, and a Pre-Feasibility Study is running on Tunkillia.

company_brief.summary: Iceni Gold Limited (ASX: ICL) is a Perth-based gold exploration company that listed on the ASX in 2021 and has operated under the same name and mineral focus since. Its flagship asset is the 14 Mile Well Gold Project in the Laverton–Leonora belt of Western Australia's Eastern Goldfields, where it is one of the larger landholders; prospects include Guyer, Goose Well, Everleigh Well, Claypan, Deep Well, North 1, Danjo NE and Monument. Guyer is subject to a farm-in and joint venture with Gold Road Resources (now Gold Fields following its 2025 acquisition), and Iceni has a separate Gold Fields farm-in of up to $10M over the Everleigh area; the company also holds the earlier-stage Welcome Creek copper-gold ground.

company_brief.summary: Koonenberry Gold Limited (ASX:KNB) is a New South Wales-focused gold and copper exploration company with no current production. Its flagship asset is the Enmore Gold Project (New England Fold Belt), acquired in late 2024, alongside its original namesake Koonenberry tenement package in far-NW NSW and a Lachlan Fold Belt copper-gold portfolio partly funded via Newmont farm-in joint ventures.

Tanami Gold NL (ASX:TAM) is a Perth-based Australian gold exploration and development company. Its current flagship asset is a 50% joint-venture interest (with MGX Resources, formerly Northern Star) in the Central Tanami Project in the Northern Territory, centred on the Groundrush gold deposit; it previously owned and operated the Coyote underground mine and Bald Hill open pit (Western Tanami Operations) in WA, which it divested (acquired by Black Cat Syndicate in 2022).

Riversgold Limited (ASX:RGL) is a Perth-based, multi-commodity mineral exploration and development company with a portfolio spanning gold, copper, lithium, uranium and rare earths across Western Australia and, since 2025, New Brunswick, Canada. Its near-term focus is converting the Northern Zone gold discovery (within its Kalgoorlie Gold Project) into production via a funded right-to-mine deal with MEGA Resources, while it continues early-stage drilling at Tambourah (Pilbara Cu-Au) and Saint John (Canada Sb-Au-Cu-Ag).

company_brief.summary: Astral Resources NL (formerly Anglo Australian Resources NL, renamed in early 2022) is a gold exploration and development company operating in the Kalgoorlie district of Western Australia. Its flagship is the 100%-owned Mandilla Gold Project (Theia, Iris, Eos, Hestia deposits) about 70 km south of Kalgoorlie, supported by the Feysville project (Kamperman) 14 km south of the Kalgoorlie Super Pit, plus the Spargoville and Carnilya Hill projects acquired via the 2025 takeover of Maximus Resources. Group mineral resource is around 2.07 Moz gold and a Mandilla pre-feasibility study with a maiden ore reserve has been completed.

company_brief.summary: High-Tech Metals Limited (ASX:HTM) is a Perth-based mineral exploration and development company. Its current focus is the Mt Fisher and Mt Eureka Gold Project in WA's Northern Goldfields (acquired from Rox Resources in 2025, anchored by the Wagtail gold deposit, now advancing toward near-term production with partner SSH Group), alongside its original Werner Lake Cobalt-Copper-Nickel Project in Ontario, Canada. It previously also held an Ethiopian lithium (LCT) exploration licence, since relinquished.

Matsa Resources Limited (ASX:MAT) is a Perth-based Western Australian gold producer and explorer, currently mining at its Devon Pit and progressing the Fortitude and Red October assets within its flagship Lake Carey Gold Project near Laverton, WA. It also holds early-stage gold/base-metal exploration ground elsewhere in WA (Lake Rebecca JV, Paraburdoo) and a portfolio of lithium and base-metal exploration licences in Thailand, alongside legacy nickel projects (Symons Hill/Fraser Range, Killaloe) that have been sold down or divested.
